component.name: Garuda Toolbox
component.summary: Maintain and configure Garuda Linux and other Arch based systems

description.p: Garuda Toolbox keeps an Arch based system in shape and changes its settings in one place. Changes are collected first, shown for review and then applied together with one password prompt.

ul.li: System updates, mirrors, keyrings and other maintenance tasks
Packages, apps and gaming software from the repositories and the AUR
Services, users, groups, kernels, locales and boot options
Config files with a backup of every change
Network tools and diagnostics reports to share when asking for help
A setup assistant for a fresh installation
